That those who would not follow the teachings of this great divine messenger would eventually be losers on this earth and in the next life. Raja Bhoj accordingly converted to Islam [116].

Q. MIRACLES PERFORMED EVEN BEFORE HIS BIRTH

Nobody can perform any miracles before his birth. The only exception has been the Comforter Saviour of the Universe. In his case the miracles before his birth have been many. One such example is quoted herein.

When Adam was created the unpolluted earth was a veritable paradise—The beautiful "Garden of Eden". Unfortunately the first Civilisation of man upon acquiring Nuclear and Scientific knowledge from the two angels fought several major Nuclear wars against the two major colonisations of men, viz. the Eastern comprising of Egypt, Mediterranean and Mesopotamia and the other, in Central America, Peru and Brazil areas. Thus vast areas of the earth were polluted. Eventually Mankind became so wicked that they completely violated the sanctity of sex and considered marriage as something outdated. Men and women freely indulged in sexual abuses which gave pleasures. Thus they prided upon their broadmindedness and freedom. The show of their parties were the beautiful dancers both male and females. In the course of dancing they would not only display their nakedness but they would also induce the honoured guests of the opposite sex to enjoy them, as they were experts at giving sexual enjoyment of every description. These led to rape, violence, insecurity, jealousies, rivalries, bloodshed and murders.

This situation demanded punishment from the Almighty. The Holy Bible has described it as:

"And God saw that the wickedeness of men was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

"And the Lord said : I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth ; both man and beast and the creeping things, and fowls of the air............

"But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord" [117].

Noah (Peace of God be on him) warned these scientifically advanced people to give up their sinful ways of freedom of sex, violence, murders, rape and disobedience of God's orders otherwise the Lord would drown them. In reply they boasted that the Almighty could not harm them by His threat of drowning as this planet was much too large with many high mountains and plateaus to be completely flooded in any one single castastrophe. Further they were ready all over the world to shoot off with most of the people then living on Earth in their Nuclear Rockets which were much more powerful than any storm that the God of Noah could bring about. As such they were more than fully confident of saving themselves. So they had no reasons whatsoever to be afraid of the Creator and His threats !

They laughed at and mocked Noah for building a wooden Ark and that also without any machineries in it to escape the deluge. It was really beyond their comprehension how a powerless craft made of wood, a very weak material, would escape the deluge when their nuclear powered space rockets made out of scientifically developed metals which were many times more powerful, stronger and safer were not going to escape according to the warnings of Noah.

So when Noah entered the Ark a radio warning was flashed all over the earth to stand by expecting the Almighty's curse. What these scientists could not anticipate, inspite of all their alertness, was that at that very moment Allah caused a big outburst in Jupiter which threw out a large white hot mass which hurtled past just missing the Earth !

It caused the Earth's atmosphere to be charged with electric energy which electrocuted all those near their Nuclear Rockets or any kind of metals or machinery. The gases from the tail of this mass burnt up a part of the Oxygen in earth's atmosphere which glowed red hot. This created a heat wave which melted the snows all over the earth including the two polar ice-caps, the icebergs, glaciers and the snows on Mountain peaks. It also rained down a liquid like thick crude oil. The gravitation pull of this huge mass from so near a distance titled the earth's axis. It upset the equilibrium of the Earth and threw out from the bowels of this planet literally many seas of hot burning lavae. Thus causing huge vacuums under the crust all over the world. This resulted in many parts of the earth's surface to be sucked in and collapse. Many Islands like Atlantis sank. The level of the ocean bed rose upward [118].

According to Cesari Emiliani of University of Miami the North American ice-cap underwent a sudden collapse followed by rapid melting. Emiliani says : "A huge amount of ice-melted water rushed into the Gulf of Mexico and produced a Sea-level rise, that spread around the world with the speed of a great tidal wave which can circle the earth in 24 hours” [119]. Emiliani's findings are corrobrated by geologist James Kennet of the University of Rhodes Island and Nicholas Shackton of Cambridge University. The burning liquids from under-ground, the melting snows, the forty days and nights of continuous down pour of heavy rains and the floods from the Oceans submerged everything including all the montains according to the Holy Scriptures [120]. A vivid example being Mount Illimani, 6457 metres above sea-level and its adjoining depression in the Andes Mountain along the Peru Bolivian border. This depression is at a height of 3810 metres above sea-level. It is 222 Kms long and 111 Kms. wide. It has a depth of 244 metres. The evidence of maritime life at this fantastic height and the ruins of Tiahuanaso found six feet below the present level of Lake Titicaca goes to show to what incredible heights the sea waters of Noah's flood rose ! (The Article "Lake on Top of the World" by James Winchester on pages 82—88 of Reader's Digest of May 1947).

Do the findings and research of scientists support the fantastic world-wide calamities of the great deluge? Here area few quotations from different experts out of hundreds that could be quoted !

"In Western North America, the Columbia River basalts compriss more than 60,000 cubic miles of piled up lava-sheets spread over a region considerably more than 100,000 square miles " [121].

"We have gained from the mulch pits of the Yukon Valley a picture of "Quick extinction". The evidences there are as obvious as in the horror camps of (Hitler's Nazi) Germany. Such piles of bodies of animals and men simply do not occur by only ordinary means" [122].

“We live in a Zoologically impoverished world, from which all the hugest and fiercest and strangest froms have recently disappeared.............. yet it is surely a marvellous fact, and one
that has hardly been sufficiently dwelt upon, this sudden dying out of so many large Mammalia, not in one place only but over half the surface of the globe (according to findings and discoveries made uptil 1962 A. D., since then the excavations show that this sudden disaster covers the whole face of the earth)" [123].

Noah took only representatives of various mammal groups— but certainly not every variety. This now clearly explains why so many mammals became extinct. We have, for example, certain species of elephants with us today but not all the different species. The woolly mammoth and mastodon, relatives of the modern elephant, died in the deluge never to be replaced again, as there is no such thing as evolution otherwise they would certainly have evolved from the ordinary elephants.

Scientific findings show that some terrible cataclysms such as the Deluge, the snow-age, sudden convulsions and upheavals of the earth's surface, or sudden alterations of conditions and other disasters have on numerous occassions in the past wiped out totally the reptiles, the mammals and several other forms of life on earth.

As a result there is not a single living thing on the face of this earth, which is 50,000 years old, or even twenty-five thousand or even ten thousand years old.

The oldest living things on the face of the earth are trees. Speaking about the "Bristlecone Pine'', the famous scientist Edmund Schulman said :

"Microscopic study of growth rings reveals that a bristlecone pine tree found last summer at nearly 10,000 feet began growing more than 4,300 years ago. Many of its neighbours are nearly
as old; we have now dated 17 bristlecone pines 4,000 years old or more" [124].

Dr. Schulman was very much puzzled with the same approximate age limit of about 4,000 years of the Giant Sequoia, trees which he had studied. These trees enjoy near-perpetual life in the absence of gross destruction, they even appear to be immune to insect attacks. Because this is so Dr. Schulman asked the following question as early as 1934 :

"Pertinent also is the well-known fact that standing snags of this species, other than those resulting from factors of gross destructions, are unknown. Does this mean that shortly preceeding 3273 years (or 4000 years ago if John Muir's somewhat doubtful count was correct) all the then living giant Sequoias were wiped out by some Catastrophe" [125].

That is something to think about : Why is it that these various varieties of still-living trees are each about 4,000 years old ? Further they seem to be the original trees that grew in their present stands ! One is tempted to ask the question : Did any terrible catastrophe occur which wiped out completely not only the entire animals and plants but even human lives just beyond the historical era i. e. around 4,000 / 4,300 years ago ? Had something happened in the recent past to wipe out the old system of things then in existence and bring into being a new system ? If it were so, then it explains everything logically and scientifically.

The Holy Bible, Tafrihul Azkia Fil Ahwal Ul Anbia, Taskiratal Anbia, the Quran and other religious scriptures tell us that about 2370 B. C. or 4355 years ago from today 1985 A. D. a great Deluge drowned and destroyed all living forms of life on this planet including the entire human race except for those eight persons in Noah's Ark. This flood not only brought thick layers of clay, and mud and maritime life from the sea beds and elsewhere over the tops of Mountains but at the same time lava flowed out of the bowels of the earth not as a stream as is now being experienced but as a veritable fiery flood. It filled the valleys, burnt up the forests, streamed out lakes and buried mountains and covered the earth with a new virgin layer of soil by effacing all signs of previous forms of life and vegetation, thereby giving a new start to many forms of animal and vegetable life on this earth. Even people living in isolation in South America have legends of this flood. The Hopi Indians living far from the sea and the Incas living high in the Peruvian Andes have legends of a great flood washing over the land covering the tops of the mountains and effacing virtually all life on earth. The cuneiform tablets dug up in Mesopotamia also speak of this terrible flood. Learned Researchers have commented :

"A deluge such as that described in the Book of Genesis occurs in the legends and folklore of almost every ancient people.

"Such agreement among the legends of so many peoples living in distant parts of the world has caused scholars in modern times to wonder whether mankind in truth experienced the worldwide catastrophe of a deluge" [126].

Nothing escaped not even men, animals and plants on the face of the earth This planet become uninhabitable for a period of 204 days in 2370 B C. according to Biblical calculations [120].

The white hot mass which caused this catastrophe and nearly destroyed the earth upon being attracted by the gravity of the Sun became its youngest planet known as Venus. It is still an inferno after 4355 years. Ridiculously it rotates backward on its axis. It takes 243 days to make one rotation on its axis. Venus takes 224.7 days to make a circumference around the Sun. Thus God has proved that He is much more powerful than Man and all his intelligence and science put together.

Just because the saviour of the Universe was going to be born in 570 A.D. from a descendant of Noah so Allah saved that helpless unpowered Ark and all that were therein which floated safely over the boiling liquid mass insulated by thick wood against both heat and electricity in the atmosphere. The Crude oil from above acted as a further preservative !

R. THE SECOND CIVILISATION OF MAN

When Noah's Ark landed upon Mount Ararat after the floods subsided there were left only Noah, his wife, his three sons and their three wives. A total of only eight human beings. Noah was over 600 years of age of that time. So he had no more children. Noah lived for 350 years after the deluge.

The second civilisation of man has come from the three surviving sons of Noah who were blessed with plenty of children after the floods :

1) Shem was the eldest son of Noah. He had a fair-coloured skin. From him has come about the basic race known scientifically as Caucasoid with colour of eyes, hair and skin light. The hair structure is fine to medium, wavy or straight. Beard and body hair is usually abundant. Nose is high and narrow. The blood group tends more towards "A" than "B". They are spread over Northern India, Iran, Middle East, Arabia, North Africa, Europe and in the European Colonies of America and Australia etc.

A group was separated in the very early stages, perhaps immediately after the curse upon the Tower of Babel. This group is commonly known as the Archiac Whites of Australia.

2) Japheth is the second son of Noah. He is the father of the Mongoloid race. His basic characteristics are :

Hair is black.
Skin is yellow.
Eyes are brown.
Eye forms are slanting but not much recessed with the Mongoloid eyefold.
Hair texture is coarse with very little beard and body hair.
Noses are moderately broad with a low bridge.
Their blood group is usually high in "B".
They are found all over Asia and the Arctic regions, excluding South West Asia, Persia, South East Asia and most parts of India.

The American Indians belong to this category of the human race. They separated from the main group shortly after the Tower of Babel incident.

3) Ham is the third son of Noah. He had a dark-brownish to back skin with woolly hair. From him have developed the dark-skinned races of the world. He is the originator of the Negroids (Africa excluding the North), Dravidians and South Indians and Hamites of Abyssinia, Eritrea and South Arabia.

Noah had a fourth son. He did not believe in God. He refused to go with his father into the Ark. Rather he made fun of Noah and his God. When the waters of the Deluge came he confidently climbed up the highest mountain in the area to save himself. The flood waters rose above the top of the highest mountain. So this wicked son of Noah was drowned with the rest of the people on earth !

The three basic types of mankind now in existence all over the world can trace their origin directly from one or more of the three sons of Noah who were saved. Hence the second civilisation of man are the children of Noah, who was himself a descendant of Adam.

In the beginning they all spoke one common language, and lived as one large joint family This unity of Mankind continued until the curse of God at the Tower of Babel. They all went to sleep speaking one language. They arose the next morning speaking different languages causing confusion, disunity and seperation This is the origin of the different races, tribes and nationalities amongst mankind !

God promised to Noah that He would never again destroy the whole of mankind by water [127]. This time the warning is that this second civilisation of man when they become equally advanced in science and evil they will destroy themselves by fire—a clear indication towards a Nuclear Holocaust or Armageddon !

Now arises the question, how can we save ourselves from Armageddon ? And safely reach the third civilisation of Man ?

chapters.heading: Chapter 9 : The Loving Being Of Light—The Comforter Of The Universe
paragraphs:
Man finds himself better off from worldly standards as far as wealth, position and influence are concerned as compared to those who claim themselves to be the Prophets of God. Naturally they contend that if there is a God, then that God is certainly giving them much more luxuries, comfort, wealth, honour, respect and position as compared to those who claim to be Prophets. On that basis they contend that they are more blessed by God on this earth in comparision to those who are Prophets. Because such is generally the case. As such they claim that by worldly standards those who are more blessed on earth than the Prophets have no necessity of such Prophets and their teachings.

Further Prophets are persons who want man to observe strict laws of goodness and piety. They feel these are very difficult for ordinary persons to live upto. As such Man considers Prophets as asking for impossible conditions to be fulfilled. So they must be off their heads or demented. Hence according to the proud and the rich, the Prophets are unsuitable for the guidance of the masses.

Man ordinarily cannot communicate with God. Yet he considers himself more knowledgeable. If he cannot communicate with God then he naturally contends that Prophets also cannot communicate with God. So in his pride and arrogance Man from time immemorial has challenged that Prophets are nothing but "Bashr" i.e. mere common persons at best like themselves.

A. MERE MORTALS (BASHR) LIKE US—BELIEF OF DISBELIEVERS

Here are a few quotations from the Quran recording the disbelievers' contentions :

"And set out for them a parable: The people of a city, when the messengers (of God) came unto them

"When We (Allah) sent to them two, they rejected both of them. Then We strengthened (them) with a third, so they said : Surely we are messengers sent to you.

"They taunted : You are naught but mere mortals (Bashr) like ourselves. The Beneficent (Creator) has not revealed any thing (unto you) ! You only lie" [128].

"They contend: O thou unto whom the Divine message is given to remind (people of the right path of Guidance), lo ! thou art indeed a madman" [129].

B. PUNISHMENT TO DISBELIEVERS WHO MOCKED PROPHETS THAT YOU ARE MERE MORTALS LIKE US

" ...Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him (by saying that you are nothing but a common mortal like us i.e. one who does not receive any Divine Guidance).

"Have they not seen how many generations We (Allah) have destroyed before them (which like the Scientifically advanced people of Atlantis, the pre-deluge civilisation of the time of Noah, Babylon, Assyria, Ninevah, Pompeii, the tribes of Thamud and Shuaib etc.) who never revived ?

"But (remember well) without exception all will be brought (out of their graves on the Day of Judgement) before Us (Allah)” [130].

"Has not the story reached you of those, who disbelieved of old (who used to mock their prophets by saying you are mortals like us and do not possess any guidance from God, rather you are mad and demented to think that we should follow such strict laws as you want us to observe) ? And so did taste of the calamities (and destruction that befell upon them) due to their conduct, and theirs will be a painful doom (in the hereafter also).

"That was because their messengers kept coming unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's sovereignty), but they mocked : Shall mere mortals guide us ? So they disbelieved and turned away. And Allah is Independent. Allah is Absolute, The Owner of all Praise" [131].

C. SOME FAMOUS CALAMITIES UPON THOSE WHO MOCKED PROPHETS

A few examples of famous disasters that befell mankind because they mocked their prophets as mere mortals are :

Noah : The Predeluge people destroyed by the Great Deluge [132].

Abraham : King Nimrod cast Abraham into a great fire. Eventually Nimrod and his mighty army met death by violence for disbelief in Abraham [133].

Lot : The people of Sodom and Gomorrah who were destroyed in the Dead Sea Disaster [134].

Moses : Pharaoh with the entire Egyptian Army was drowned when crossing along the sea bed of the Red Sea [135].

D. IS THE LOVING BEING OF LIGHT A HUMAN BEING ACCORDING TO QURAN ?

We human beings have been created out of "Dust" or "Clay" [136]. The Holy Prophet Mohammad has been made out of "Allah's Nur" or "Allah's Light" [137]. It will therefore be evident that he is from a totally different element as compared to us. So there can be no comparison between him and us.

"Had We (Allah) appointed an angel (i.e. one made out of 'Nur' as the Angels are or as Prophet Mohammad is is made of the 'Nur' or 'Light' of Allah We (Allah) assuredly (would) have made him (to appear before mankind as) a (common) mortal and (Allah has thus) hidden from them i.e. Mankind (the truth of who or what His Messenger Mohammad in reality is). This is a matter in which they (Mankind) have already been covered with ignorance" [138].

"Say (unto them O Mohammad ! by My Order) : Verily, am I (who is made out of the 'Nur' or 'Light' of Allah) a (common) mortal like you (who is made out of clay) ? It is inspired (by Allah) in me (the book of guidance i.e. the Quran and through it) that your Lord is only a single God (have you been similarly inspired with a Book of Guidance from the Alimighty ?) and I seek (continuously) forgiveness (for my followers) from Him (from the time of my birth when I miraculously spoke and said : "Rabbi Habli Ummati" i.e. O Sustainer of the Universe forgive those who follow me [139]. And which I continued praying for my followers until my departure from earthly life. Have you also miraculously spoken thus upon your birth asking for forgiveness of your followers and do you also pray continuously for the forgiveness of all your followers as I did even until and upon my death bed ?—Nay) and (so) woe unto polytheists (i.e. those who in their pride upon their wordly knowledge and power think and imagine themselves to be like mortals or equals of Mohammad and Allah causes such to be covered in ignorance as warned in the above quotation of the Quran)" [140].

E. HOW THE LOVING BEING OF LIGHT IS TO BE HONOURED

Because the Holy Prophet Mohammad (Peace of Allah be on him) is far superior to any other creation so Allah has passed the following orders on Man:

"And lo! those who disbelieve, would do everything in their power to shake thee (i.e. thy faith with the power of their eyes. And when they hear the Reminder they say : lo ! he is indeed mad".

"But indeed he (Mohammad) is naught else than one who is remembered by the entire Universe (including even Allah and His Angels)" [141].

"Lo ! Allah and His Angels remember by sending 'Salluna' (glorification) on the Prophet (because he is Nur-e-Mohammadi from which everything in the Universe has been created). O Ye who believe ! You also send 'Salluna' on him and offer 'Sallemu' (i.e. Peace of Allah) to him in a worthy manner" [142].

"O ye who believe ! When it is said 'Make room in the assemblies (for the Holy Prophet)', then make room, Allah will also make a room for you (in Heaven). And when it is said 'stand up out of respect (for the Prophet), then immediately stand up (as mark of respect to the Prophet). Allah will exalt the position of those amongst you who believe in these orders (to stand up to pay respect to the Holy Prophet) and those who have knowledge to high ranks. Allah is well informed of what ye do" [143].

F. SOME OF THE DIVINE HONOURS BLESSED UPON THE LOVING BEING OF LIGHT

The Quran informs in two of its Ayats that if all the Oceans of the earth were to become ink and if all the trees were made into pens to write down the praise of Allah and yet seven similar sets of Oceans were added to provide more ink, but they all will not be enough to write the praises of Allah e.g. :

"And if all the trees in the earth were pens and (similarly all) the Oceans (of the earth) with seven more (sets of) Oceans to help it (were ink) , the words of (praise of) Allah would not be exhausted (when all these pens and ink would have become exhausted). Lo ! Allah is Mighty, Wise" [144].

So no attempt is being made herein to describe the Wonders that Allah is because He is undescribable. But He out of His kindness has blessed a very few of His remarkable qualities upon the Loving Being of Light, the Comforter Saviour of the Universe, the Holy Prophet Mohammad :

The Atributes of Allah => The Blessings gifted by Allah upon Mohammad the Saviour of the Universe :

1. THE KALIMA

“There is none worthy of Divine worship save Allah" [145].

"Mohammad is the Messenger of Allah" [146].

2. FOR THE ENTIRE UNIVERSE

"Praise be to Allah, the sustainer Lord of the entire Universe" [147].

"We (Allah) have sent thee (O Mohammad) not as anything but as a Mercy (i.e. Saviour) for the entire Universe" [148].

3. NUR OR THE BEING OF LIGHT

"......Allah is "Nur-un-ala-Nur" or Light upon Light......." [149].

"......Now indeed has come unto you (for your guidance) the Holy Prophet (Mohammad)........who is a being out of Allah's Nur.............. [150].

4. GIVER OF LIGHT

"Allah is the Nur or Light of the heavens and the earth........" [149].

"O Prophet (Mohammad) ! Lo ! We have sent thee as a witness and bringer of good tidings, and a warner.

"And as a summoner unto Allah by His permission and as a shining Sun that spreads the light" [151].

5. LEADS FROM DARKNESS INTO LIGHT

"Allah! is the protecting friend of those who believe. He brings them out of Darkness into Light......” [152].

"Alif Lam Ra. (This is) a scripture entire mankind from darkness into which We (Allah) have revealed unto thee (Oh Mohammad) that thereby thou mayst bring forth Light......." [153].

"(Mohammad is) The Messenger reciting unto you the revelations of Allah made clear so that he may lead the believers and those who do good deeds from darkness into Light" [154].

6. THE FULL OF PITY—THE MERCIFUL

".......for Allah is ‘Raufur Rahim’ (i.e. full of Pity, the Merciful)" [155].

"There has come unto you (Mohammad) a messenger (from Allah) who is Aziz (i.e. far Superior) than any of you. Who is full of concern for you if you are overburdened with difficulties. For the believers he is 'Raufur Rahim' (i.e. full of Pity, the Merciful)” [156].

7. THE MOST FORGIVING

"......Lo ! Allah is Relenting, Merciful" [157].

"... Lo ! He is ever Clement, Forgiving" [158].

".......Now indeed Our (Allah's) Messenger (Mohammad) has come unto you (for your guidance).
He is repeatedly most forgiving……..” [159].

8. OBEDIENCE OF ALLAH & MESSENGER

"Whose obeyeth Allah and the Messenger (Mohammad), they are with those upon whom Allah has blessed with favours. They comprise of Prophets, and the Saints and the martyrs and the righteous. The best of friends are they !" [159].

"Whose obeyeth the Messenger, (Prophet Mohammad) indeed obeyeth Allah and whoso turneth away, We (Allah) have not sent thee (O Mohammad) as a saviour for them" [160].

9. BAIYAT – SWEARING OF ALLEGIANCE

"Lo ! those who swear allegiance (i e. do Baiyat) unto thee (Mohammad), swear allegiance only unto Allah. The Hand of Allah is above your hands. So whosoever breakes his oath, breakes it only to his Soul's hurt ; while whosoever keeps his covenant (with thee keeps his covenant) with Allah, on them will He bestow immense rewards" [161].

10. ALLAH'S CURSE UPON THOSE WHO SHOW DISRESPECT TO THE LOVING BEING OF LIGHT

"Lo ! those who malign Allah and His Messenger (Mohammad), Allah has cursed them in this world and the Hereafter and has prepared for them the doom of the disdained" [162].

The very same warning has been given by Jesus on pages 225-227 of "Gospel of Barnabas".

11. ORDER NOT TO ADDRESS THE HOLY PROPHET AS YOU ADDRESS ONE ANOTHER

Because Mohammad is so much different to ordinary human beings so Allah has passed the following order :

"Do not address the Messenger (Mohammad) amonges you in the same manner as you would address one another............Therefore let those who conspire to evade (Allah's) orders (by claiming and treating Mohammad as a common human being or "Bashr") beware lest grief and a painful punishment befall them" [163].

12. ORDER NOT TO ADDRESS MOHAMMAD EVEN AS "FATHER".

“Mohammad is (so much different and superior from you O mankind ! that he can) not (even be referred to as) the father of any man among you (Papa or the term father has always been regarded as the most honourable and respectful term by which we human beings honour our elders but this Ayat of the Quran forbids us from calling Mohammad even as "Father"), but he is the Messenger of Allah (which none of you are) and he is the Seal of the Prophets (i.e. the final Prophet or the promised Prophet and that no more Prophets are going to be born on this earth after him. Such an honour has not been given to any of the earlier great Prophets) and Allah is aware of all facts (as to who or what the Prophet Mohammad is i.e. Nur-e-Mohammadi out of a very small dot or piece of which how many millions of galaxies have been created comprising of how many billions of stars, planets, satellites, meteorities, comets and other wonders comprising the Universe, which we human beings inspite of all our scientific progress have not yet been able to calculate and find out and of which we form such a very small insignificant part)" [164].

G. THE FIRST REVELATION OF THE QURAN

Mohammad is 40 years old in 610 A.D. This is his fifth annual retreat, each for a month during the month of Ramadhan to contemplate upon the Divine Creator of the Universe. He was meditating in "Gar-e-Hira" (Cave of Research) on Jabl-e-Nur (Hill of Light) about 6 miles from Macca.

The Holy Quran informs that around the end of this month was the Night of Qadar or Power:

"Lo ! We (Allah) have sent down (the Holy Quran) during the Night of Power.

"Ah ! what will convey unto you what the Night Power is ?

"The Night of Power is better than 1000 months of prayers or piety (i.e. this one night is better than 83 years of prayers).

"The Angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of the O Lord, with all His decrees.

"(That night is) Peace until the rising of dawn" [165].

This discloses the following facts :

1) That the Quran was sent down from Heaven during this night.

2) Prayers during this one night is better than 1000 months or over 83 years of prayers.

3) Angel Gabriel descended from Heaven with the Lord's decrees.

4) A Spirit also descended. A Spirit is superior to Angels. Now arises the question as to who or what this “Spirit" was ? We have to confine ourselves to what has been revealed in this Surah. In the very first verse we are told that the Quran was sent down. So it will be clear that this Spirit was the “Spirit of the Quran". Now let us ask : What is the Quran ? The Quran is the words of Allah. It issued from Him. It is not a created thing. This "Spirit of the Quran" came and entered into the breast of Mohammad. As such the Holy Prophet came to know by heart the full Quran by the inspiration of Allah directly reaching him.

5) Thereafter a shining figure with 700 wings with human features appeared before him and commanded : "READ". Mohammad replied : "I read not".

6) This reply conveyed two meanings, firstly I have not been taught by any worldly teachers how to read or write. The second meaning is : Who are you to ask me to read or why should
I read at your request ?

7) Thereupon this personage took Mohammad to his breast and pressed him. The Prophet said he was pressed so hard that he felt as if his ribs would break and pierce his lungs. Then this figure released him and said again "Read". Mohammad gave the same reply. So the shining figure again pressed him for the second time and upon releasing said for the third time. Said “Read". Mohammad gave the same reply. For the third time he pressed Mohammad to his breast and upon releasing him asked again "Read".

8) Thereupon Mohammad asked who are you to ask me to read and what do you want me to read. The vision replied I am Angel Gabriel the bringer of messages of Allah to convey to the earlier prophets of Allah.

9) Angel Gabriel said I want you to :

"Read : In the name of the Lord, Who createth" [166].

10) As soon as Mohammad realised he was being requested to read in the name of Allah he replied, Do you want me to read about that Creator of the Universe :

“ Who Createth man from a clot" [167].

Angel Gabriel replied : "Yes indeed" to which the Prophet replied :

"Read : that the Lord is the Most Bountiful".

"Who teacheth by the pen".
